evidence.subject: Update README.md: Add documentation section, gap report references, and architecture doc links

justification: Tier 2 (AI-actor email pattern) was used because Tier 1 (Co-authored-by trailer search) yielded zero matches across all refs. The earliest commit whose author email matches the AI-actor pattern '@blitzy.com' is 803732e140796ac4db4343c22791025b6503885c, authored by 'Blitzy Agent <agent@blitzy.com>' at 2026-02-25T02:58:59Z. The author email pattern was matched against the configured set: '@blitzy.com', 'blitzy[bot]@users.noreply.github.com', 'copilot@github.com', 'noreply@anthropic.com'. This commit is the second commit on main; it is the FIRST agent-authored commit, marking the inflection from human-only (baseline, michael@blitzy.com) to AI-authored development.

alternatives_considered.result_detail: Zero commits across all refs (refs/heads/, refs/remotes/, refs/tags/) contain any Co-authored-by, Assisted-by, or Generated-by trailer matching an AI-tool pattern. Verified via 'git log --all --grep=Co-authored-by: | wc -l' returning 0.
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: No signal: zero commits across all refs contain any AI-tool Co-authored-by, Assisted-by, or Generated-by trailer.

alternatives_considered.method: Two-sided rolling-mean ratio of weekly commit counts (4-week windows on each side), seeking the first week where ratio >= 4.0x sustained above 2.0x for >= 4 subsequent weeks
alternatives_considered.result_detail: Tier 3 (velocity inflection) was not evaluated because Tier 2 (ai_actor_email) yielded a definitive signal. Documented here for transparency: weekly commit counts on main in this repository are 1 (week of 2026-02-22), 31 (week of 2026-02-23), then increasing — a clear inflection consistent with the Tier 2 date but reported with lower confidence than the direct author-email signal.
alternatives_considered.reason_rejected: Not evaluated: Tier 2 (ai_actor_email) yielded a definitive signal, so Tier 3 was skipped per the precedence rule. Tier 3 would have identified the same week (2026-02-23) but with lower confidence than the direct author-email match.

phase_decomposition.ramp_up_steady_state_split_reason: Per DL-006 fallback: post-introduction span (86 days) is shorter than 90 days; AAP §0.5.3 mandates baseline/post-introduction-only reporting in this case. See decision-log.md DL-006.
